study.scope: Complete fixed colored still experiment; registered crest with authored water continuation and clouds. No boats or Fuji. No production migration or procedural claim.
uncertainty: Second broad mask experiment: only source-observed open paper bays are cut; actual pale/cyan foam is retained even where the scan-hidden mask consequently remains plain.
W011/W014 tips are unchanged. Exterior-bay edges include explicitly interpreted uninked segments; the lower domain cut omits the unrelated lower-left family rather than implying a physical wave edge.
Principal-water cove heads and other W016 fringe joins remain provisional. Thin interior ink and wash are unmodeled. This is not a full-crest fidelity or whole-scene acceptance.

W020 joins use declared root color diagnostics; pale x185–225 and x399–426 root intervals continue as paper/foam rather than water. Microtexture and interpreted band directions may still reveal registration boundaries.
Principal-water mask is unused and unverified; original registered color layers retain source appearance.
Foreground and right swell are authored interpretations, not source reconstructions.
